resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Fire Lookout Association index says Gone; both lookout pages say Abandoned. The story reports both and gives no date for either.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. All four sources give only the 1930s, so no event year is recorded. The index says Gone while both lookout pages say Abandoned; the story reports both. No staffing, fire or built-date events were found. One WebSearch returned a master list and an association history, neither about this tower. No photos with usable URLs were found. The access note is a placeholder: the landowner is not named in any source.
